alt: Close-up of a polished slice of stromatolite rock showing wavy, rust-brown and cream layers.
note: Strong layered stromatolite texture (CC BY 2.0). Note: Mesoproterozoic Belt Supergroup example, not Shark Bay; fine as a generic stromatolite. Rejected cand-2 (satellite bay), cand-3 (unclear rock on grey), cand-4 (muddy outcrop, unrecognisable).
